name: WWE NXT UK
description: A professional wrestling program showcasing the best of WWE's UK division.

videos.title: United Kingdom Championship Tournament Part 1
videos.overview: The first ever WWE United Kingdom Champion will be crowned in a grueling two-day tournament, LIVE from Blackpool, England.

videos.title: United Kingdom Championship Tournament Part 2
videos.overview: The first ever WWE United Kingdom Champion will be crowned in a grueling two-day tournament, LIVE from Blackpool, England.

videos.title: United Kingdom Championship Special
videos.overview: The Superstars of the WWE UK Championship Tournament and 205 Live descend upon Norwich, England for an unforgettable special event!

videos.title: 2018 UK Championship Tournament
videos.overview: The 2018 WWE United Kingdom Championship Tournament continues from London, England as 8 competitors all vie for a shot at the UK Title!

videos.title: NXT UK Championship
videos.overview: The 2018 UK Tournament winner faces champ Pete Dunne in an epic battle! Plus, NXT's best TAKE OVER London as this historic event concludes!

videos.title: NXT UK TakeOver: Blackpool
videos.overview: Witness the first-ever NXT UK TakeOver in Blackpool, England, featuring WWE UK Champion Pete Dunne against Gallus' Joe Coffey.

videos.title: NXT UK TakeOver: Cardiff
videos.overview: The superstars of UK NXT comes to Cardiff to challenge each other to see who is the best.

videos.title: NXT UK TakeOver: Blackpool II
videos.overview: NXT returns to Blackpool as superstars fight each other to show who is the best.

videos.title: NXT UK 01
videos.overview: On the first episode of NXT UK, Pete Dunne defends his WWE United Kingdom Title against Noam Dar. Plus, Toni Storm and others in action!

videos.title: NXT UK 02
videos.overview: Tyler Bate goes one-on-one with Wolfgang in the main event. Plus, Zack Gibson speaks out, Killer Kelly battles Dakota Kai, and more!

videos.title: NXT UK 03
videos.overview: Noam Dar and Zack Gibson look to settle their explosive rivalry in the main event. Plus, Trent Seven takes on Saxon Huxley, and much more!

videos.title: NXT UK 04
videos.overview: Mark Andrews battles Wolfgang in an exciting main event, Sam Gradwell and Saxon Huxley take on Moustache Mountain, and more!

videos.title: NXT UK 05
videos.overview: Danny Burch challenges Pete Dunne for the WWE United Kingdom Championship. Wolfgang and The Coffey Brothers make an emphatic statement.

videos.title: NXT UK 06
videos.overview: Mark Andrews, Flash Morgan and Ashton Smith combat Wolfgang and The Coffey Brothers in the main event. Trent Seven confronts Zack Gibson.

videos.title: NXT UK 07
videos.overview: A brand-new championship is unveiled to the world. Wolfgang looks to assert his dominance in the main event. Tyler Bate faces Ashton Smith.

videos.title: NXT UK 08
videos.overview: The tournament to crown the NXT UK Women's Champion begins with two exciting bouts. A brawl breaks out when Trent Seven faces Zack Gibson.

videos.title: NXT UK 09
videos.overview: The tournament to crown the first NXT UK Women's Champion continues with Xia Brookside, Rhea Ripley, Isla Dawn and Toni Storm in action!

videos.title: NXT UK 10
videos.overview: The tournament to crown the first NXT UK Women's Champion reaches the Semifinals with Toni Storm, Dakota Kai, and more in action!

videos.title: NXT UK 11
videos.overview: Jordan Devlin challenges Pete Dunne for the WWE UK Championship. Millie McKenzie and Xia Brookside take on Charlie Morgan and Killer Kelly.

videos.title: NXT UK 12
videos.overview: The tournament to crown the first-ever NXT United Kingdom Women's Champion concludes with Rhea Ripley and Toni Storm battling for the gold.

videos.title: NXT UK 13
videos.overview: The returning Travis Banks confronts Wolfgang and his allies. Flash Morgan Webster takes on Jordan Devlin in the main event.

videos.title: NXT UK 14
videos.overview: Travis Banks and Wolfgang face each other in a main event showdown. Plus, Rhea Ripley, Ligero and many more in action!

videos.title: NXT UK 15
videos.overview: Trent Seven and Joe Coffey take to the ring to settle their problems. Plus, Killer Kelly, James Drake and more!

videos.title: NXT UK 16
videos.overview: Eddie Dennis and 'Bomber' Dave Mastiff meet in a hard-hitting main event. Zack Gibson and James Drake make their intentions known.

videos.title: NXT UK 17
videos.overview: The NXT UK Women's Championship is on the line, as Rhea Ripley defends her title against Isla Dawn. Plus, Moustache Mountain and more!

videos.title: NXT UK 18
videos.overview: While continuing to call out Pete Dunne, Joe Coffey gears up for the main-event action. Fabian Aichner interferes in a tag team match.

videos.title: NXT UK 19
videos.overview: During a special announcement by NXT UK General Manager Johnny Saint, Toni Storm seizes an opportunity to further her in-ring career.

videos.title: NXT UK 20
videos.overview: Deonna Purrazzo challenges Rhea Ripley for the NXT UK Women's Championship in the main event. Eddie Dennis sends a message to Dave Mastiff.

videos.title: NXT UK 21
videos.overview: Joe Coffey and WWE UK Champion Pete Dunne continue their explosive rivalry during a tag team match between Gallus and Moustache Mountain.

videos.title: NXT UK 22
videos.overview: Physicality breaks out when WWE UK Champion Pete Dunne and Joe Coffey meet to sign the contract for their upcoming match.

videos.title: NXT UK 23
videos.overview: Gallus send a message to anyone who stands in their way. Jinny makes her intentions known. Mark Andrews and Flash Morgan Webster unite.

videos.title: NXT UK 24
videos.overview: As NXT UK TakeOver: Blackpool approaches, British Strong Style battle all three members of Gallus in a Six-Man Tag Team Match main event.

videos.title: NXT UK 26
videos.overview: See exclusive matches from Blackpool, including Mark Andrews and Flash Morgan Webster taking on Fabian Aichner and Marcel Barthel.

videos.title: NXT UK 27
videos.overview: Pete Dunne comes face-to-face with a new threat to his WWE United Kingdom Championship. Travis Banks faces Jordan Devlin in the main event.

videos.title: NXT UK 28
videos.overview: WALTER makes his in-ring debut against Jack Starz. Also, Zack Gibson and James Drake learn of new challengers to the NXT UK Tag Team Titles.

videos.title: February 06, 2019
videos.overview: WALTER continues to live up to his reputation in a main event battle against Gallus' Mark Coffey. Rhea Ripley takes out her frustrations.

videos.title: February 13, 2019
videos.overview: A verbal confrontation between Toni Storm and Rhea Ripley erupts in physicality. Pete Dunne faces Wolfgang in the main event.

videos.title: February 20, 2019
videos.overview: Rhea Ripley challenges Toni Storm for the NXT UK Women's Championship in the main event. Danny Burch and Oney Lorcan arrive.

videos.title: February 27, 2019
videos.overview: Danny Burch and Oney Lorcan challenge The Grizzled Young Veterans for the NXT UK Tag Team Titles in the main event.

videos.title: March 06, 2019
videos.overview: The main event sees Travis Banks and Jordan Devlin battle it out in a Falls Count Anywhere Match.

videos.title: March 13, 2019
videos.overview: WALTER and WWE United Kingdom Champion Pete Dunne take on Mark and Joe Coffey in the main event. Noam Dar returns with a new attitude.

videos.title: March 20, 2019
videos.overview: Pete Dunne lets everyone know who he wants to defend his WWE United Kingdom Championship against at NXT TakeOver: New York.

videos.title: March 27, 2019
videos.overview: WALTER and Pete Dunne meet face-to-face to sign the contract for their upcoming match for the WWE United Kingdom Championship.

videos.title: April 3, 2019
videos.overview: The Grizzled Young Veterans address the challengers for their NXT UK Tag Team Titles. Trent Seven faces Joe Coffey in the main event.

videos.title: April 10, 2019
videos.overview: Jinny challenges Toni Storm for the NXT UK Women's Championship in the main event. Plus, Piper Niven takes to the ring to face Killer Kelly.

videos.title: April 17, 2019
videos.overview: Kenny Williams and Amir Jordan face The Grizzled Young Veterans in the main event, while Rhea Ripley targets Kacy Catanzaro.

videos.title: April 24, 2019
videos.overview: Toni Storm makes a vow. Kay Lee Ray battles Xia Brookside. Moustache Mountain faces Flash Morgan Webster and Mark Andrews in the main event.

videos.title: May 1, 2019
videos.overview: A WWE United Kingdom Champion WALTER faces Jordan Devlin in the main event, Pete Dunne demands a rematch for the title he lost.

videos.title: May 8, 2019
videos.overview: The Grizzled Young Veterans defend the NXT UK Tag Team Titles in the main event.

videos.title: May 15, 2019
videos.overview: Ligero, Jordan Devlin, Wolfgang, and Dave Mastiff look to qualify for the WWE UK Championship No. 1 Contender's Fatal 4-Way Match.

videos.title: May 22, 2019
videos.overview: Pete Dunne and WALTER look to exceed expectations in another epic clash for the coveted WWE United Kingdom Championship.

videos.title: September 17, 2020 - Returns Live
videos.overview: Live show returns

videos.title: NXT UK #127
videos.overview: Piper Niven and Jinny battle to determine the No. 1 Contender to Kay Lee Ray's NXT UK Women's Championship.

videos.title: NXT UK #128
videos.overview: NXT UK Champion WALTER puts his title on the line against A-Kid. NXT UK Women's Champion Kay Lee Ray comes face-to-face with Jinny ahead of their title showdown.

videos.title: NXT UK #129
videos.overview: NXT UK Women's Champion Kay Lee Ray puts her championship and historic title reign on the line against No. 1 Contender Jinny.

videos.title: NXT UK #130
videos.overview: Andrews & Webster, Smith & Carter, The Hunt and Pretty Deadly collide in an NXT UK Tag Team Championship No. 1 Contenders Elimination Four Way Match. Ben Carter is in action following his impressive debut.

videos.title: NXT UK #131
videos.overview: Jordan Devlin faces his next challenger in the NXT Cruiserweight Championship Open Challenge. Nina Samuels battles Xia Brookside.

videos.title: NXT UK #132
videos.overview: Mark Andrews & Flash Morgan Webster collide with The Hunt in a Street Fight. Joshi legend Meiko Satomura makes her highly-anticipated NXT UK debut. Noam Dar's “Supernova Sessions” returns with guest Sha Samuels.

videos.title: NXT UK #133
videos.overview: Rampage Brown collides with Joe Coffey in a head-to-head showdown. A-Kid battles Sha Samuels in a Heritage Cup Match.

videos.title: NXT UK #134
videos.overview: Gallus and Pretty Deadly battle for the NXT UK Tag Team Championship. Xia Brookside faces Nina Samuels with the loser becoming the winner's personal assistant.

videos.title: NXT UK #135
videos.overview: Kay Lee Ray, the longest-reigning NXT UK Women's Champion in history, defends her title against Joshi legend Meiko Satomura.

videos.title: NXT UK #136
videos.overview: Piper Niven joins forces with Jack Starz to take on Jinny & Joseph Conners in the first Mixed Tag Team Match in NXT UK history. Kenny Williams & Amir Jordan battle Flash Morgan Webster & Mark Andrews. Teoman makes his debut.

videos.title: NXT UK #137
videos.overview: After successfully making the 205-pound weight limit, Trent Seven challenges Jordan Devlin for the NXT Cruiserweight Championship. NXT UK Champion WALTER makes a statement.

videos.title: NXT UK #138
videos.overview: Ilja Dragunov collides with Sam Gradwell in a No Disqualification Match. Jack Starz clashes with Joseph Conners.

videos.title: NXT UK #139
videos.overview: In their first title defense, Pretty Deadly put the NXT UK Tag Team Championship on the line against Kenny Williams & Amir Jordan.

videos.title: NXT UK #140
videos.overview: Three huge matches highlight NXT UK Prelude, a special WrestleMania Week episode of NXT UK. WALTER defends his NXT UK Title against Rampage Brown. NXT UK Women's Champion Kay Lee Ray teams with Isla Dawn against Meiko Satomura & Emilia McKenzie. Tyler Bate collides with Noam Dar in an NXT UK Heritage Cup Title No. 1 Contender's Match.

videos.title: NXT UK #141
videos.overview: Amir Jordan and Kenny Williams go head-to-head as the two former tag team partners look to settle their differences. Gallus return with an appearance on Noam Dar's “Supernova Sessions.” Nathan Frazer faces Saxon Huxley.

videos.title: NXT UK #142
videos.overview: Tyler Bate & Trent Seven are back together as Moustache Mountain to take on Noam Dar & Sha Samuels. Joe Coffey collides with Eddie Dennis.

videos.title: NXT UK #143
videos.overview: Gallus collide with Eddie Dennis, T-Bone & Primate. Meiko Satomura battles Aoife Valkyrie in a highly-anticipated showdown. Rohan Raja makes his NXT UK debut against Teoman.

videos.title: NXT UK #144
videos.overview: Former tag team partners Amir Jordan and Kenny Williams battle in a No Disqualification Match with the loser leaving NXT UK. Ilja Dragunov collides with Dave Mastiff. Noam Dar's "Supernova Sessions" welcomes special guest Nathan Frazer.

videos.title: NXT UK #145
videos.overview: Five women compete in a Gauntlet Match to determine the No. 1 contender to Kay Lee Ray’s NXT UK Women's Championship. Nathan Frazer battles Noam Dar in a Heritage Cup Rules Match.

videos.title: NXT UK #146
videos.overview: A-Kid battles Tyler Bate for the NXT UK Heritage Cup Championship. Noam Dar hosts "Supernova Sessions" with special guest Ilja Dragunov.

videos.title: NXT UK #147
videos.overview: Sam Gradwell gets his wish when he faces Trent Seven. Nathan Frazer and Sha Samuels settle their differences in a head-to-head showdown.

videos.title: NXT UK #148
videos.overview: Two of NXT UK's hardest hitters collide when Rampage Brown and Joe Coffey clash in a huge rematch. Ilja Dragunov battles Noam Dar.

videos.title: NXT UK #149
videos.overview: Kay Lee Ray defends the NXT UK Women's Championship in a highly-anticipated rematch against Meiko Satomura. NXT UK Champion WALTER returns.

videos.title: NXT UK #150
videos.overview: For the first time in nearly two years, there is a new NXT UK Women's Champion. Subculture face Jinny & Joseph Conners in a Mixed Tag Team Match. Wolfgang looks to silence Sam Gradwell in a head-to-head battle. Jordan Devlin joins Noam Dar's "Supernova Sessions."

videos.title: NXT UK #151
videos.overview: Ilja Dragunov, Rampage Brown and Joe Coffey battle in a Triple Threat Match to see who is NXT UK’s toughest competitor. Oliver Carter collides with Teoman.

videos.title: NXT UK #152
videos.overview: New NXT UK Women's Champion Meiko Satomura makes her first appearance since her title victory. A-Kid collides with Jordan Devlin.
